name: Cheesy Egg, Sausage, Potato & Bell Pepper Breakfast Casserole

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 350°F. Coat a large baking dish with a thin layer of oil and set aside.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add frozen roasting vegetables and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes. Transfer to the baking dish. (Reserve skillet for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
2 (397 g) bag frozen roasting vegetables (potatoes, peppers, onions)

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are done, return skillet to medium-high heat. Add sausage and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 6-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, use a spatula to break the potatoes into bite-sized pieces.
When the sausage is done, add to the baking dish with the roasting vegetables and set aside.
Wash, dry, trim, and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Sprinkle over the baking dish.
Coarsely grate cheese. Sprinkle over the baking dish, then stir to combine and spread out in a "loose" even layer.
Place eggs, milk, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Whisk to combine, then pour over the breakfast casserole.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup whole milk
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place casserole in the oven and bake until the top is golden and eggs are set in the center, 40-45 minutes. Remove from oven.
Cut casserole into 8 pieces and serve warm. Enjoy!
